title: Rationale
html:
Rationale

How “China invades Taiwan by June 30, 2027” matches “Will China invade Taiwan by June 30, 2027?”

A longshot contract held to mid-2027: at 4.2 cents the price is consistent with a risk-neutral probability anywhere from about 1.5% to 4.3% once the cost of tying up money is counted, and such contracts carry lottery demand on the Yes side. Its book is $204 deep. I read it as an upper bound and state my own figure, which follows it.
